name: codex-herdr-pane
description: Runs every Codex delegation (codex exec, codex review) and every ccx task in a visible herdr pane with a live log and a rendered answer, and closes the pane when it finishes

direction.title: Split direction
direction.description: Where the Codex pane opens, relative to the pane Claude Code runs in

layout.title: Pane layout
layout.description: auto tiles, or splits Claude's pane downward when direction is down; tile places panes in a grid beside Claude (right of it first, then 2x2); right or down always splits Claude's pane that way

maxPanes.title: Most delegation panes at once
maxPanes.description: tile only: a run beyond this many live panes goes ahead without a pane and says so

closePane.title: Close the pane when Codex finishes
closePane.description: always closes it after the delay; success keeps a failed run open; never leaves it for you

closeDelay.title: Seconds to wait before closing
closeDelay.description: A short pause so the final state can be read

viewer.title: Pane view
viewer.description: textual shows a live log and the answer as Markdown (needs uv; the first run downloads Textual); plain streams the cleaned log

tailLines.title: Log lines returned to Claude when there is no answer file
tailLines.description: After a failure, or for codex review, the Bash call returns the end of the cleaned log

maxReturnLines.title: Most lines returned to Claude per section
maxReturnLines.description: The answer, the log tail after a failure and the output of the rest of a chained command are each cut to this many lines, with one line naming the file that holds the rest; the status line is never cut. 0 returns everything

leanProfile.title: Use the lean Codex profile
leanProfile.description: Adds -p <profile name> to codex exec calls that set no profile, when ~/.codex/<name>.config.toml exists; codex review is untouched

leanProfileName.title: Lean profile name
leanProfileName.description: The profile passed with -p; its file is ~/.codex/<name>.config.toml

ccxRunsDir.title: ccx run-log directory
ccxRunsDir.description: Where ccx writes each run's stream-json log; the pane follows the new log a run creates. CCX_RUNS_DIR overrides it. Empty: $HOME/work/_shared/claude-container/runs
